sources.purpose: federal contract opportunity discovery and notice data
sources.live_claim_rule: current opportunity details must be fetched from SAM.gov at runtime
award and incumbent claims require current source evidence
do not represent Grants.gov as a source of personal-benefit grants

sources.purpose: small-business federal contracting guidance, readiness and assistance-program research
sources.live_claim_rule: certification or program eligibility must be verified; never inferred from user description alone
use current regulation text and preserve citations/provenance

sources.purpose: early market research and future procurement planning
sources.live_claim_rule: forecast is not an active solicitation or award
jurisdiction-specific registration and rules require current verification

guardrails: no bid submission without explicit user approval
no legal interpretation represented as attorney advice
respect portal/API terms and anti-bot controls
store no government credentials in benchmark data
truth_rule: A source adapter may research and organize public procurement information, but an opportunity, registration, certification, deadline, set-aside or award status is current only when supported by runtime evidence from the authoritative source.
